edits.ko: 새티스팩토리의 열차를 보세요. 선로가 휘어지는 동안 열차의 위치와 나아가는 방향이 함께 바뀝니다. 이런 길을 숫자로 적고, 그 위의 다음 위치를 구하려면 어떻게 해야 할까요? 먼저 곡선의 표현에서 시작해, 원하는 점을 지나게 만들고, 출발과 도착 방향까지 잡아 보겠습니다.
edits.en: Watch the train in Satisfactory. As the track bends, the train changes both position and travel direction. How can we describe such a path numerically and find the next position on it? We will start with curve representations, then make a curve pass through chosen points, and finally control its departure and arrival directions.
edits.reason: Resolve the hypothetical opening with observed moving train; preserve the complete parametric representation→interpolation→Hermite scope.
edits.screen: After2sbranding, native Satisfactory702–730 train along bending track; open curve on visible rail. Transition to the same Unity route model while the overview continues; no freeze or forced gameplay stretch.

edits.ko: 슈퍼 마리오 메이커 투에서는 캐릭터가 올라탄 초록 발판이 세로 트랙을 따라 올라갑니다. 길의 모양과 그 길 위의 현재 위치는 서로 나눠 생각할 수 있죠. 같은 움직임을 우리 예제로 만들어 보겠습니다.
edits.en: In Super Mario Maker 2, a green platform carries the character upward along a vertical track. The shape of the route and the object's current position on it can be treated separately. Let us build that distinction in our own example.
edits.reason: Observed platform on fixed route motivates t update without claiming Nintendo uses polynomial evaluation.
edits.screen: Maker2 local60–72: boarding→platform rises. Contour follows platform, small vertical route guide. Continue actual narration over our model p(t); never add a fabricated t measurement on game.

edits.ko: 마리오 갤럭시에서는 스타를 타고 다음 행성으로 날아갑니다. 휘어진 길을 지나는 동안 나아가는 방향도 달라지죠. 이제 우리가 만드는 곡선에서 그 순간의 방향을 구해 보겠습니다.
edits.en: In Super Mario Galaxy, a Launch Star sends Mario toward the next planet. His travel direction changes along the curved flight. Now let us calculate the instantaneous direction on the curve we are building.
edits.reason: Actual launch→curved flight→arrival supplies a3D direction example before tangent definition; no hidden interpolator or ballistic claim.
edits.screen: GalaxySwitch local90–104 full action at native speed. Mark actual star then short path trail. Transition to our tangent arrow on p(t), retain source aspect.

edits.ko: 새티스팩토리에서 선로를 이을 때는 연결할 끝을 움직이면 미리 보이는 선로의 굽은 모양도 달라집니다. 우리 경로도 도착 위치만 맞추는 데서 한 걸음 더 나아가, 양 끝에서 나아갈 방향까지 정해 보겠습니다.
edits.en: When connecting rails in Satisfactory, moving the proposed endpoint changes the bend of the preview. For our own path, let us go beyond matching destination positions and specify how the curve leaves and reaches its endpoints.
edits.reason: Observed endpoint/preview/build sequence motivates Hermite endpoint derivatives, without treating source preview as Hermite proof.
edits.screen: Satisfactory258–285 actual preview→build; label endpoints only while visible, clear at underwater view. Our Hermite model then exposes actual p0,p1,v0,v1.

corrections.enTo: We often use zero to one, but that interval does not automatically mean one physical second. Curve values can also represent properties such as color or intensity rather than spatial coordinates. Here we will follow moving paths.
